sarah: quick sync — partner asked for a lightweight terraform starter kit + refarch for Azure Marketplace billing integration. want to scope minimal viable deliverables before EOW :calendar: 
aj: sounds good. goal: 1) terraform module for marketplace deploy 2) reference arch diagram 3) quickstart lab with sample config. e2e demo for partner next tuesday?
sophie: +1. i'd push to include a 'customer-onramp' variables.tf so partners can swap in their vnet/subnet/kms values. keeps our snippets clean.
devon: question: do we need to support both marketplace SaaS and private offer flows? that affects the ARM template vs ARM + Terraform overlap.
sarah: partner specifically asked for private offer flow first. later we can add a SaaS/publisher example. for now terraform + az cli steps ok.
aj: i'll own the terraform module. plan: repo under github.com/redwood-inference/marketplace-onramp-azure. module path: modules/azure-marketplace-onramp. i'll add README + usage.
sophie: i can draft the refarch diagram and quickstart doc. will include recommended network, kms, and compromise checklist (no public LB for admin endpoints).
devon: tagging infra checklist: monitoring, alerting, and telemetry forwarding — will add a small runbook for ops handoff.
sarah: yay. can we agree on acceptance criteria? 1) terraform module with examples for private-offer deploy 2) sample variables for partner swap 3) README with manual & automation steps 4) simple canary plan for marketplace rollout
aj: agree. ETA for PR -> branch 'marketplace-onramp/initial' by Fri COB.
sophie: i'll aim to have diagrams + quickstart draft by Fri as well.
terra-bot: CI status: new repo scaffold committed. template CI pipeline available at .github/workflows/terraform.yml
sarah: next steps: aj create repo + initial module skeleton, sophie draft docs & diagrams, devon write ops runbook stub. i'll coordinate partner demo invite once we have an internal dry-run. tagging @aj @sophie @devon — pls ack here when you have a working PR. :thumbsup:
aj: ack.
sophie: ack.
devon: ack.
sarah: thanks everyone — keeping this thread as single place for updates. if you hit blockers DM me.
